title: Spinach and Sweet Potato Side
preamble:
Ingredients:-
2
orange-fleshed sweet potatoes , cut into chunks
200g
spinach , washed & roughly chopped
4
naan bread , warmed through
400g
tin coconut milk
1
onion , finely sliced
2-3
madras curry paste , depending on how hot you like your curry

2-3

Method:-
Fry the onions until very soft, about 8 minutes. Stir in the paste and fry for 2 minutes. Add the coconut milk and sweet potatoes and cook until just tender, about 10 minutes. Stir through the spinach until wilted. Serve with naan breads.
